subject: Safety-net approval & maintenance docket — Private upgrade (version lock / rollback)
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: jordanm@acmehealth.com
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Safety-net approval & maintenance docket — Private upgrade (version lock / rollback)

Team — putting this thread together to lock the operational plan for Acme Health's private deployment upgrade next week. TL;DR: we need a 4-hour maintenance window, a short canary slice, and explicit rollback acceptance from the customer and security. Please review the docket below and respond with ack/edits by EOD tomorrow.

Planned upgrade scope:
- Upgrade Redwood Private control-plane components from v1.12.3 -> v1.13.0 (minor: infra + CVE fixes)
- Apply serving runtime patch (latency regression fixes) to the Acme on-prem fleet (GPU nodes only)
- No model topology changes; KV cache format unchanged

Proposed maintenance window:
- Option A (preferred): 2026-12-18 22:00 - 02:00 UTC (4 h)
- Option B (backup): 2026-12-19 00:00 - 04:00 UTC (4 h)

Canary plan:
- 2-host canary in Acme staging (10% traffic), 30m soak, smoke tests (tokens/sec, tail-latency, error-rate)

Rollback criteria (high level):
- Error-rate > 1% sustained over 10m OR
- 95th-percentile latency increase > 40% vs baseline OR
- Customer-critical route failures (as defined in INF-7891)

Action items for this thread:
1) Karthik — confirm exact KV-drain and cache-warm steps + estimated per-node downtime.
2) Soojin — request prod cert reissue window & confirm audit log retention for the window.
3) Stephanie — approve the maintenance window from Ops governance and add bridge/responder list.
4) Jordan (Acme) — please confirm blackout acceptance and escalation contacts.

Attachments: maintenance-checklist-20261210.xlsx (checklist + rollback playbook)

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 17:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Safety-net approval & maintenance docket — Private upgrade (version lock / rollback)

Monica — quick tech notes and clarifications below. I skimmed the checklist; adding two attachments: canary-matrix-20261210.csv and kv-drain-snippet.sh.

Notes:
- KV drain: we should do a soft prefix-evict then hard drain on canary hosts only. Estimated per-host downtime: ~2-4 minutes during final commit. We need a precise order: control-plane -> serving runtime -> health-checks -> traffic shift back. I'll paste the short sequence at the bottom of this email for the runbook.

- Canary timing: propose 45m total (10m deploy, 30m soak, 5m rollback decision). 30m soak is borderline; if Stephanie requires longer we can extend to 45m soak but then the window needs +30m.

- Version lock: we will apply a strict version-lock on the Acme fleet after the update (control-plane pin) for 72 hours to prevent accidental drift; rollback will re-open pin.

- Telemetry: request that Acme enable verbose telemetry for the window (sampling=100%) to INF-7891. Need lower-level logs for the first 30m post-deploy.

Sequence snippet (simplified):
1) Snapshot configs (etcd snapshot)
2) Drain KV on canary hosts (kv-drain-snippet.sh)
3) Apply runtime binary + restart serving process
4) Wait for health checks (30s interval, 3 successful)
5) Shift 10% traffic to canary via smart-router
6) Soak + smoke tests
7) Promote to next tranche or rollback as required

I'll be available on the bridge for the run.

Karthik Iyer
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Mills <jordanm@acmehealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: noc@acmehealth.com
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 20:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Safety-net approval & maintenance docket — Private upgrade (version lock / rollback)

Monica — thanks for the clear plan. Acme can support a maintenance window but prefer Option B (2026-12-19 00:00 - 04:00 UTC) to avoid late-evening traffic. Our escalation contacts are included on cc. Two asks from our side:
1) Please include the business-impact checklist (what customer endpoints will see brief degraded throughput vs total outage).
2) We need the signed attestation that audit logs for the window will be exported and retained for 90 days for our compliance team.

We approve the canary approach. Confirm you will share the jittered deploy timeline at least 24h prior.

Jordan Mills

jordanm@acmehealth.com
